idea-plugin.name: Checksum & Regex Playground
idea-plugin.description:
Checksum & Regex Playground

A tool window for QA / fintech / KYC engineers. Paste any identifier and instantly see which real-world checks it passes — no browser, no guesswork, fully offline.

  • Checksums tab: pick a type to load a valid example (or type / paste your own) and it live-validates against every applicable algorithm — IBAN (ISO 7064 mod-97), card Luhn, VAT (DE/GB/CY/NL), Dutch BSN, AU TFN/ABN, BIC/SWIFT, GB NINo, German ID card (ICAO 7-3-1), ISIN, IMEI, EAN-13, LEI, VIN, ISBN-10/13, JMBG, crypto addresses (Bitcoin Base58Check, Ethereum EIP-55), and the Russian ИНН, СНИЛС, ОГРН, ОГРНИП. Each check shows ✔ pass or ✘ fail.
  • Regex tab: a live regular-expression tester — pattern + text → matches with capture groups and positions, with clear syntax-error messages. Toggle flags (ignore-case, multiline, dot-all, extended), pick a ready-made pattern (email, IPv4, URL, UUID, date…), and try a live replace with $1 group references.

Open it from View ▸ Tool Windows ▸ Test Data Playground. Uses the same validated engine as the Kassi Test Data generator.

More Kassi tools for QA & fintech: Kassi Test Data — generate valid IBANs, cards, BIC/SWIFT, VAT and national IDs (the inverse of this validator).

Source, issues & docs: github.com/VadimToptunov/kassi-plugins
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.8.0

  • New check: Norwegian VAT / MVA orgnr (mod-11).

1.7.0

  • New check: Danish VAT / CVR (mod-11).

1.6.0

  • New check: Finnish VAT / ALV (weighted mod-11).

1.5.0

  • New check: ICCID SIM-card numbers (Luhn).

1.4.0

  • New check: ISO 6346 shipping-container codes.

1.3.0

  • Parity with the generator: the Checksums tab now validates VIN (ISO 3779), ISBN-10/13, JMBG (ex-Yugoslav ID), and crypto addresses — Bitcoin (Base58Check) and Ethereum (EIP-55, real Keccak-256) — all available in the type picker too.

1.2.0

  • Regex tab upgrade: flags (ignore-case, multiline, dot-all, extended), a ready-made pattern library (email, IPv4, URL, UUID, ISO date, hex colour…), and a live replace with $1 group references.

1.1.0

  • Type picker in the Checksums tab: choose a type (IBAN, card, ISIN, IMEI, EAN, LEI, ИНН, СНИЛС, ОГРН…) to load a valid example, instead of guessing from a hint. Pasting your own value still works.

1.0.2

  • More checks: ISIN (ISO 6166), IMEI, EAN-13, LEI, and Russian ИНН (individual & legal), СНИЛС, ОГРН, ОГРНИП — the validator now covers far more of what Kassi Test Data generates.

1.0.1

  • Listing: link to the companion Kassi Test Data generator and the source repository. No functional changes.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: live checksum inspector + regex tester tool window.
